deliverables.purpose: A2 portrait main poster — the primary deliverable and consistency anchor for the entire visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: All required info present (IEEE VIS 2026, dates, location, tagline, 6 research areas, logo lockup). Geometric forms abstract, not literal charts. Dark background. Bold typography dominant. Swiss/International style.

deliverables.purpose: Square key visual / master visual — the campaign seed that proves the visual idea works standalone
deliverables.acceptance_test: Geometric forms and conference name readable at thumbnail size. Works as profile image. Same palette and motif as main poster.

deliverables.purpose: Typography system board demonstrating type scale, weights, and hierarchy across all roles
deliverables.acceptance_test: All 5 type roles visible with clear differentiation. Scale ratios apparent. Grid alignment visible. Monospace for data values.

deliverables.purpose: Color palette and visual rules board documenting the system for cross-format consistency
deliverables.acceptance_test: All 8 palette swatches visible with hex labels. Motif examples shown. Format adaptation logic clear.

deliverables.purpose: Twitter/X post — landscape social media adaptation of the main poster visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: Conference name, dates, location readable. Geometric motif present. Works at social feed scale. Same palette as anchor.

deliverables.purpose: Twitter/X header banner — wide panoramic adaptation of the visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: Conference name and dates readable. Geometric forms spread across wide format. Works as profile header.

deliverables.purpose: LinkedIn post — professional social media adaptation with call-to-action
deliverables.acceptance_test: Conference name, dates, location, and CTA readable. Professional tone. Same visual system as anchor.

deliverables.purpose: Instagram post — square social media adaptation of the visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: Conference name and dates readable at Instagram feed scale. Same geometric motif and palette.

deliverables.purpose: Instagram story — vertical social media adaptation with call-to-action
deliverables.acceptance_test: Conference name, dates, location, and CTA readable in vertical format. Same visual system.

deliverables.purpose: Conference badge and lanyard — physical touchpoint adaptation of the visual system
deliverables.acceptance_test: Badge shows conference name, dates, location. Lanyard has repeating pattern. Role labels visible. Professional and functional.

deliverables.purpose: PPT/Keynote template — presentation system with title and content slide layouts
deliverables.acceptance_test: Title slide and content slide both visible. Logo lockup on title slide. Geometric accent present. Content slide has clear hierarchy. Works for academic presentations.
